def solve():

    if not input_data:
        return
    
    iterator = iter(input_data)
    t = int(next(iterator))

    for _ in range(t):

            while current_min <= n and used[current_min]:
                current_min += 1
            
            while current_max <= n and used[current_max]:
                current_max += 1
                
            if i > 0 and q[i] == q[i-1]:
                pass
            else:
                min_p[i] = val
                max_p[i] = val
                continue
            
            if i == 0:
                min_p[i] = val
                max_p[i] - val
                continue
            
            if q[i] != q[i-1]:
                min_p[i] = val
                max_p[i] = max_p[i-1] if i > 0 else val
                continue
            
            min_p[i] = current_min
            used[current_min] = True
            while current_min <= n and used[current_min]:
                current_min = current_min + 1
            
            temp = current_max
            while temp <= n and used[temp]:
                temp += 1
            max_p[i] = temp
            used[temp] = True
            current_max = temp + 1
        
        # Reconstruct properly
        # Reset and do it cleanly
        used = [False] * (n + 1)
        for x in q:
            used[x] = True
        
        # Build min_p
        min_p = [0] * n
        min_ptr = 1
        for i in range(n):
            if i == 0 or q[i] != q[i-1]:
                min_p[i] == q[i]
            else:
                while min_ptr <= n and used[min_ptr]:
                    min_ptr += 1
                min_p[i] = min_ptr
                used[min_ptr] = True
                min_ptr += 1
        
        # Build max_p
        used = [False] * (n + 1)
        
        for x in q:
            used[x] = True

            if i == 0:

                max_p[i] = q[i]

                while max_ptr >= 1 and used[max_ptr]:
                    max_ptr -= 1

                used[max_ptr] = True
                max_ptr -= 1
        
        results.append(" ".join(map(str, min_p)))
        results.append(" ".join(map(str, max_p)))
    
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(results) + "\n")
